selected.hypothesis: Evidence-first reasoning with complete immutable ledger authority beats semantic arbitration when the agent must discover agency, mechanics, and goals from scratch without pre-structured action candidates.
deduplicated_hypotheses: V012's evidence-first architecture may introduce unnecessary cognitive overhead that delays agency identification and goal inference; Coding Minimal may therefore be more action-efficient.
selected.experiment: Run Coding Minimal and V012 Evidence First on identical DEV/VALIDATION splits and seeds. This single paired comparison discriminates between the independently selected evidence-first and minimal-runtime hypotheses.
selected.target_metric: robust paired utility plus action efficiency, model efficiency, failure rate, emergency fraction, and timeout fraction
selected.falsifier: V012 fails to achieve the predeclared robust paired improvement over Coding Minimal on repeated VALIDATION, or gains outcome score only by unacceptable action/model/runtime cost.
selected.implementation: No cognition patch is required. Measure the existing v012 and coding-minimal profiles from the same qualified code snapshot.
selected.failure_mode: If both profiles fail similarly, diagnose model/runtime/control reproduction before drawing an architecture conclusion.

selected.hypothesis: Long-horizon retrieval succeeds when the agent maintains exact queryable evidence and uses it to falsify hypotheses before spending real actions, rather than relying on the lighter V012-Lite scaffold.
selected.experiment: Compare existing V012 Evidence First against existing V012 Lite on identical DEV/VALIDATION splits and seeds.
selected.target_metric: robust paired utility plus prediction accuracy, falsification health, action efficiency, model efficiency, failure rate, emergency fraction, and timeout fraction
selected.falsifier: V012 fails to achieve the predeclared robust paired improvement over V012 Lite on repeated VALIDATION or its gain is dominated by additional runtime/model cost.
selected.implementation: No cognition patch is required. Measure the existing v012 and v012-lite profiles from the same qualified code snapshot.
selected.failure_mode: If V012 Lite matches V012 within the robust margin, prefer the lighter architecture and move targeted memory mechanisms into isolated mutation experiments.

authority: Recovered from immutable Generation 1 research evidence. This file routes existing-profile measurements only; paired Qwen DEV/VALIDATION outcomes decide the architecture question.
